tasks.label: Abrir log das rotinas (hoje)
args: $d = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd'; $dir = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'logs\routines'; if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { Write-Host "Pasta inexistente: $dir" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }; $hoje = @(Get-ChildItem $dir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*$d*" } | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending); if ($hoje.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host "NENHUM log com a data de hoje ($d) em $dir" -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host 'Ultimos 5 arquivos que existem:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Get-ChildItem $dir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ($_.LastWriteTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') + '  ' + $_.Name) }; exit 1 }; Write-Host "=== logs/routines (*$d*) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; $hoje | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ($_.LastWriteTime.ToString('HH:mm:ss') + '  ' + $_.Name + '  ' + [math]::Round($_.Length/1KB,1) + 'KB') }; Write-Host ''; foreach ($f in ($hoje | Select-Object -First 3)) { Write-Host "-------- $($f.Name) (tail) --------" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Get-Content $f.FullName -Tail 25 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
tasks.detail: Logs do dia em logs/routines, tail dos 3 mais recentes (procure FIM: / GUARD_OK). Falha se não houver log de hoje.
